description: Prompt mapping for every sound effect in the repo (music and voice lines are excluded; see the exclusion lists in tests/unit/soundEffectsPromptMapping.test.js). Every new or changed sound effect under public/sound/ (or public/mine_explosion.mp3) must get an entry here in the same commit.
provider: ElevenLabs Sound Effects (owner's ElevenLabs Starter plan, commercial license)

status_values.regenerated-v3: Regenerated with eleven_text_to_sound_v3 from the original prompt; previous holds the replaced take.
status_values.unknown-prompt: Original prompt not traceable; file unchanged (none left since 2026-11-20).

note: Signed media URLs are never stored here. Re-fetch raw takes with creative_get_generations(flow_id, generation_ids). Durations are the shipped file durations; v3 one-shots were trimmed of leading silence, kept at least 90 % of the previous length (quiet tail kept or padded) and cut at 110 % at most. prompt_source "reconstructed-from-audio-analysis" marks prompts written on 2026-11-20 from an analysis of the previous file because the original prompt was unknown.

rework_2026_11_19.settings: Same prompt and prompt_influence as the original; duration_seconds = shipped duration of the previous file (minimum 0.5 s); loop = original loop flag (battleshipCruise and hovercraftMoving set to loop because the game plays them as movement loops).
rework_2026_11_19.processing: ffmpeg/numpy: one-shots trimmed of leading silence (-48 dBFS) with 3 ms fade-in and 12 ms fade-out; loops kept native when the seam is clean, otherwise an equal-power head/tail cross-fade; integrated loudness matched to the previous file (ffmpeg loudnorm meter, clips under 0.5 s peak-matched); lookahead limiter at -1.5 dBFS; MP3 128 kbps / 44.1 kHz with the previous channel count.
rework_2026_11_19.qa: Per file: duration within ±10 % of the previous file, loudness within 1 LU, no clipping, no mostly-silent output, loop seam jump below 4× the p99 sample step and RMS step below 3 dB, and a Whisper check that no speech was generated. At most one retake per sound.

reconstruction_2026_11_20.method: Each previous file was analysed (duration, envelope, LUFS, true peak, spectral centroid and bands per quarter, dominant pitch track, onsets/periodicity, stereo width, loop seam, spectrogram) together with its use in src/. A prompt was written from that, generated once with eleven_text_to_sound_v3 at the previous duration and loop flag; when the result was clearly a different kind of sound (centroid ratio outside 0.5-2 or envelope correlation below 0.3) it got one retake with a refined prompt and the closer take was kept.
reconstruction_2026_11_20.loudness: Matched to the previous file within 1 LU where that needed at most 14 dB of peak limiting at -1.5 dBFS. Many previous files are clipped or brick-walled (true peak up to +2.3 dBTP); those are left quieter than before, see result.processing per file.
